assets.label: Clevylo ${nextRelease.version} for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)

plugins.releaseBodyTemplate:
${nextRelease.notes}

## Download and install

Download `Clevylo-${nextRelease.version}-macOS-universal.zip`, expand it, and move **Clevylo.app** to **Applications**. Requires macOS 14 or later; includes Apple Silicon and Intel binaries. `Clevylo-macOS-universal.zip` is an identical copy for the stable download link. `appcast.xml` is the signed in-app update feed. `SHA256SUMS` covers both archives and the feed.

This app is **ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized**. If macOS blocks the first launch, follow [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445) for allowing this specific app. After the first installation, choose **Clevylo → Check for Updates…** or open **Settings → Updates** to download and install new versions in the app. Update feeds and downloads use Ed25519 signatures and do not require a paid Apple developer account. Your library is stored separately from the app.

## Verification

Release policy tests and macOS unit tests passed before publication. Packaging verified the extracted app's signature, version, minimum OS, both binary architectures, absence of debug entitlements and test bundles, and the signed update feed and archive against the public key embedded in the app. Intel execution, macOS 14 execution, GUI smoke testing, and live model inference remain separate manual checks. See [release documentation](https://github.com/culpen90/Clevylo/blob/v${nextRelease.version}/docs/RELEASING.md).
